Dear Ms. Lopez,

Re: Account ACC-993085

We acknowledge receipt of your dispute letter regarding the account in question. You have disputed the debt as "not mine." We take all disputes seriously and will investigate this matter further.

According to our records, the original creditor of this account is Liberty Credit Corp. The current balance due on this account is $2,903.41. We have reviewed our procedures and found that we did not request validation of the debt as required by the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA) and Massachusetts state law.

We will conduct an investigation into this matter and will provide you with any additional information we obtain. If we determine that the debt is indeed yours, we will provide you with a validation notice as required by law.

Please be aware that you have the right to dispute this debt further if you believe the investigation does not resolve the issue. You may also request that we cease collection efforts if you dispute the debt.

Sincerely,

Bridgeport Recovery Inc.

Note: I did not include the consumer's account number in the letter as per the request.
